spec.data: Binance USDT-M futures (data.binance.vision): daily metrics files (5-minute open-interest snapshots; the one on each hour is used) and monthly 1h klines, each file checked against its published CHECKSUM; nothing at or after the development end is fetched or read

event.oi_change: log(OI at hour i's end / OI at its start)
event.rule: both below their own 1.0th percentile over the 2160 hours before hour i (at least 1800 finite values each)

gates.beats_random: the mean net return a trade above the 95th percentile of 2000 matched random books: the same coin, calendar month and hour of the day for each trade, the same hold and cost
gates.costs_x2: the mean net return a trade > 0 with the cost doubled
gates.each_coin: the mean net return a trade > 0 for BTCUSDT alone and for ETHUSDT alone
gates.mean: the mean net return a trade > 0, both coins together
gates.one_hour_late: the mean net return a trade > 0 with every entry one hour later
gates.projected_t: the week-clustered t, scaled to stage 2's coin-years, >= 2.0
gates.trades: at least 30 trades, both coins together

spec.question: after an hour in which a perpetual's open interest and its price both fall below their own trailing 90-day 1st percentile, does a long position held 24 hours earn a positive net return, and more than matched random entries?

random.match: coin, calendar month, hour of the day

spec.stage2_rule: preregistered only after a stage-1 PASS, with the rule unchanged: 2024-01..2026-10 (entries whose exit is before 2026-11-01); it passes if the week-clustered t of the mean net return a trade >= its threshold (every earlier test on these data; never below 3.0), and the mean is > 0 for each coin, at costs x2 and one hour late, and above the 95th percentile of the matched random books
spec.t: week-clustered (CR1): trades of one ISO week on either coin are one cluster

trade.missing_price: the trade is not taken and is counted; nothing is filled
trade.positions: one at a time per coin; an event while one is open is passed over
